CREATE TRIGGER Wymiary_InsertHandler ON [CDN].[Wymiary] FOR INSERT, UPDATE AS begin declare @_wmr_id int create table #wmrRodzice (WmrID int, Poziom int)
if @@ROWCOUNT = 1 begin set @_wmr_id = (select top 1 wmr_id from inserted ) insert into #wmrRodzice (WmrID, Poziom) values (@_wmr_id,0) insert into #wmrRodzice execute cdn.WmrRodzice @_wmr_id
update cdn.wymiary set wmr_rootid = (select top 1 wmrid from #wmrRodzice order by poziom desc) where wmr_id = @_wmr_id end else begin set nocount off declare wym_kursor cursor for select wmr_id from inserted
open wym_kursor fetch next from wym_kursor into @_wmr_id while @@FETCH_STATUS=0 begin delete from #wmrRodzice insert into #wmrRodzice (WmrID, Poziom) values (@_wmr_id,0) insert into #wmrRodzice execute cdn.WmrRodzice @_wmr_id
update cdn.wymiary set wmr_rootid = (select top 1 wmrid from #wmrRodzice order by poziom desc) where wmr_id = @_wmr_id fetch next from wym_kursor into @_wmr_id end
close wym_kursor deallocate wym_kursor set nocount on end
drop table #wmrRodzice end
